summary: Central Asia's largest startup ecosystem, centred on Astana Hub (Astana) and Almaty. About US$209m raised by Kazakh IT startups in 2025, dominated by AI. Notable successes include Kaspi.kz and Higgsfield AI.
startup_visa: No standalone startup visa. Astana Hub participants get a simplified visa and labour regime, and Astana Hub runs a Digital Nomad Visa / Residency for IT specialists, https://astanahub.com/l/digital-nomad
company_setup: LLP (TOO) registered online via egov.kz in 1-3 days. Foreigners usually incorporate in person or through a representative. AIFC (Astana) offers a common-law jurisdiction for funds and fintech. Astana Hub participants get 0% CIT/VAT on qualifying IT income.

summary: Fast-growing ecosystem anchored by IT Park in Tashkent and the state fund of funds UzVC. Strengths are IT outsourcing, fintech and edtech. Uzum is the best-known tech company.
startup_visa: No startup visa. Uzbekistan offers an IT visa for IT specialists, IT company owners and investors through IT Park, https://outsource.gov.uz/
company_setup: LLC registered via the one-stop shop in about 1-3 days. 100% foreign ownership allowed. IT Park residents pay 0% corporate tax, 0% social payments and 7.5% personal income tax.

summary: Tbilisi-centred ecosystem driven by the state agency GITA, which has funded 640+ startups with grants and runs accelerators with Plug and Play, Startupbootcamp, 500 Global and Founder Institute. Easy incorporation and low taxes attract relocating founders.
startup_visa: No startup visa. Citizens of about 95 countries get visa-free stays of up to 1 year, https://www.evisa.gov.ge/GeoVisa/
company_setup: LLC or Individual Entrepreneur registered at the Public Service Hall (NAPR) in 1 day, possible through a representative with power of attorney. Small Business status gives 1% turnover tax; Virtual Zone status gives 0% CIT on foreign IT income.

company_setup: LLC registered online via the e-register in 1-2 days, with free state registration. Foreigners can register through a representative. A turnover-tax regime is available for small businesses.

summary: Baku-centred ecosystem led by the state Innovation and Digital Development Agency (IDDA), which absorbed the former Innovation Agency, and the SMB Development Agency (KOBIA). IDDA reports 750+ startups supported, but the private VC base is small.
company_setup: LLC registered via the State Tax Service e-registration or ASAN centres in about 1-3 days. Foreigners can own 100%. A KOBIA Startup Certificate gives a 3-year exemption on income from innovation activity, and Texnopark residents get 10-year tax benefits.
